name: @w6w-apps/webex
description: Manage Webex spaces, messages, memberships, teams and webhooks — the Webex Messaging API.

w6w.longDescription:
Cisco Webex is the messaging, meeting and calling platform behind Webex App and Webex Calling. This app covers the Webex Messaging REST API: rooms (spaces) — creating, reading, updating, deleting and listing them; messages — posting, editing, reading, deleting and listing, including direct 1:1 threads; memberships — adding, updating, removing and listing who belongs to a room; teams and team memberships — the same lifecycle one level up, for a named group of rooms; and webhooks — subscribing to the resource/event pairs Webex fires so a workflow can react instead of poll.

A handful of read-only People lookups round it out (your own profile, another person's profile, and organization search) — Webex's own guidance is that People is being superseded by SCIM 2.0 for provisioning, so this app does not add, update or remove people; it only reads.

A fit for turning an external event into a Webex space with the right people in it and a first message posted, keeping a team's space roster in sync with some other system of record, or wiring a webhook so a workflow starts the moment someone posts, joins or leaves.
